description.value:
Evokers are naturally attuned with latent ether locked within inanimate or inorganic objects, which can range from rocks, water, the earth, metals or even the wind. They possess specialized glands in their limbs that allow them to process and draw out the ether from the environment, often unconsciously. Evokers specialize in this ability, often leading them to make use of tools and catalysts in their spell casting more than any other aetherfont. By bringing out the ether already stored in objects, evokers can conserve and pace themselves by using less of their own.

Evoker Focus Point Feature

Evokers naturally regain Focus Points up to their maximum during exploration, as described in the Evoker Refocus feature. If it has been an hour since the last time they managed to Refocus or use a focus point, they regain all their focus points. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.feats.l3ecoYD2MwGUJhaa]{Spell Catalyst} free action.

Evoker Refocus

Evokers do not need to perform dedicated activities to Refocus as their bodies naturally take trace amounts of ether from the world around them. As long as they do not perform any strenuous activity such as combat, heavy travel or spellcasting, they are able to perform any other Exploration activity as part of their Refocus, regardless of their source of focus spells. At the end of a ten-minute period of these light activities, they regain one focus point.

If you take a feat that improves your Refocus, you can take up to two qualifying items you can use for Spell Catalyst and drain it during your Refocus. This acts as if the item had been used for Spell Catalyst, but you regain an additional focus point for each item you drain within the ten-minute period.
